ValidationRule.description: An upcoming webinar is advertised with a Sign up action, which needs a registration link. Save-time only: once the event date passes the link is optional. Mirrored server-side in ResourceAdminController.saveResource.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Resource_Type__c, "Webinar"), NOT(ISBLANK(Event_Datetime__c)), Event_Datetime__c > NOW(), ISBLANK(Registration_URL__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Upcoming webinars need a registration URL so people can sign up.
